vcard-edge.purpose: LynkVCard face for the Free tier (card list, card detail, onboarding, store and marketing); the same card in every theme

vcard-hub.alt: Brushed silver LynkVCard for the Plus tier: a hub with three lines running out to three nodes, the LynkOmni logo, masked number dots and the line HUB // CENTER POINT.
vcard-hub.purpose: LynkVCard face for the Plus tier (card list, card detail, onboarding, store and marketing); the same card in every theme

vcard-core.alt: Jet black LynkVCard for the Pro tier: a glowing green core dot inside a spend ring that is partly filled, the LynkOmni logo, masked number dots and the line CORE // DEEP SYSTEM.
vcard-core.purpose: LynkVCard face for the Pro tier (card list, card detail, onboarding, store and marketing); the same card in every theme

vcard-omni.alt: Solid obsidian LynkVCard for the Max tier: an engraved sphere, the LynkOmni logo, a polished edge, no number on the front, and the line OMNI // OWN ALL COMMERCE.
vcard-omni.purpose: LynkVCard face for the Max tier (card list, card detail, onboarding, store and marketing); the same card in every theme

diagram-vcard-tiers.alt: Diagram of the four LynkVCard tiers (Free EDGE, Plus HUB, Pro CORE, Max OMNI) with price, number of cards, monthly spend limit, users and main feature.
diagram-vcard-tiers.purpose: Pricing page and help centre: what each card tier gives; every number comes from services/billing.py

vcard-edge-back.alt: Back of the slate EDGE LynkVCard: a dashed frame where the issuer shows the card details, and the LynkOmni logo. No number is drawn.
vcard-edge-back.purpose: Back of the Free LynkVCard: shows where the licensed issuer displays the card details

vcard-hub-back.alt: Back of the silver HUB LynkVCard: a dashed frame where the issuer shows the card details, and the LynkOmni logo. No number is drawn.
vcard-hub-back.purpose: Back of the Plus LynkVCard: shows where the licensed issuer displays the card details

vcard-core-back.alt: Back of the black CORE LynkVCard: a dashed frame where the issuer shows the card details, and the LynkOmni logo. No number is drawn.
vcard-core-back.purpose: Back of the Pro LynkVCard: shows where the licensed issuer displays the card details

vcard-omni-back.alt: Back of the obsidian OMNI LynkVCard: a dashed frame where the issuer shows the card details, the LynkOmni logo and the words LynkOmni Reserve Network. No number or bank name is drawn.
vcard-omni-back.purpose: Back of the Max LynkVCard: shows where the licensed issuer displays the card details
